description:
Get the whole x402 market as one dataset: every active seller with rank, 30-day calls, estimated revenue, paying wallets, categories and unusual-number labels, plus category totals. Rebuilt weekly from Coinbase's Bazaar catalog.

$0.10 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote.

When to use: You are analysing the whole x402 market and want every seller in one file.
Use instead: x402_seller_lookup or best_x402_tools for a single seller or task (cheaper).
Returns: every active seller with rank, 30-day calls, revenue estimate, paying wallets, categories and labels, plus category totals. Rebuilt weekly. Takes no parameters.

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.
